tricks.trick: B-D-D: Basin = area drained; Divide = highland that Divides; Drainage = the whole river Design of a region.

tricks.concept: भारत में अपवाह तंत्र – हिमालयी और प्रायद्वीपीय नदियाँ
tricks.trick: H-P: Himalayan = Always (Himalaya ice + rain); Peninsular = Rain only (monsoon dependent).
Indus five friends: Jhelum-Chenab-Ravi-Beas-Satluj meet near Mithankot — 'JCRBS join Indus'.
Ganga friends: Yamuna (right bank twin) + Ghaghara-Gandak-Kosi (flood+fertility) + Chambal-Betwa-Son (peninsular). Delta = Sundari → Sundarban.
Name-change trip: Sangpo → Dihang → Brahmaputra → Jamuna. Silt Superstar = course changer + Majuli maker.

tricks.concept: प्रायद्वीपीय नदियाँ – नर्मदा, तापी, गोदावरी, महानदी, कृष्णा और कावेरी
tricks.trick: East BIG-K: Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Kaveri → Bay + Delta. West NT: Narmada-Tapi → Arabian Sea + Estuary. Godavari = Dakshin Ganga.
Oxbow = river meander cut; Lagoon = coast (Chilika); Salt = Sambar; Fresh giant = Wular; Dam lake = Guru Gobind Sagar.
